context: Representative diagnostics implementation cleanup: boolean-only conflict checks may stay, but value-reading selector and output branches should use Optional boundaries.

checklist.name: Creates revised diagnostics command
checklist.description: Creates DiagnosticsCommand.java with select, finish, write, print, Manifest, and Selection.

checklist.name: Preserves conflict check
checklist.description: Keeps the mutual-exclusion behavior and exact --board/--workflow exception message.

checklist.name: Uses selector Optional boundaries
checklist.description: Uses board.map(...).orElseGet(...) with a nested workflow boundary, binds values once, or otherwise avoids presence-check/value-read selector branches.

checklist.name: Uses output side-effect boundary
checklist.description: Uses output.ifPresentOrElse(...) or an equivalent Optional side-effect boundary instead of isPresent() plus orElseThrow()/get().

checklist.name: Avoids null/list workaround
checklist.description: Does not unwrap single Optionals with orElse(null), local null branching, stream().toList(), lists, or loops.

checklist.name: Preserves selection behavior
checklist.description: Returns board, workflow, and all selections correctly, including configDir.resolve(workflowValue).

checklist.name: Preserves output behavior
checklist.description: Calls write only when output is present and print only when absent.
